name: Hearthswarming Heat
source: Ponka Pone invites you to a Hearthswarming party, will you go? What lewd shenanigans will ensue? Are you brave enough to woo a married mare?
translation: Ponka Pone invites you to a Hearthswarming party, will you go? What lewd shenanigans will ensue? Are you brave enough to woo a married mare?
